summary.text: Restricted zone of Jade Pool blessed land where an illusory peach forest covers a sea of grass and flowers.

claims.text: Captivating sea is a restricted region of Jade Pool blessed land. It mainly consists of a forest of illusory peach trees. Under the trees is a sea of grasses and flowers. Large patches of groundmat grass are like endless green carpets. The sea of colorful flowers gives off a deep fragrance, and tens of thousands of poisonous purple heart flowers are close to blooming.

Fairy Li Shan names the place to Fang Yuan and Hei Lou Lan while they contest Jade Pool blessed land. She lists large patches of groundmat grass like green carpets, colorful flowers with a deep fragrance, and tens of thousands of poisonous purple heart flowers close to blooming, then says those hazards are only small problems for Gu Immortals. A group of peach wolves, nearly thirty strong, dwells in the forest, and captivating sea itself is a Gu formation. In its depths lies Miniscule Mountain, with Gu Immortals whose auras and numbers are unclear. Fang Yuan judges that Fairy Li Shan and Hei Lou Lan already broke through to the depths of the sea of flowers and were forced back, so the defense exceeds his most hopeful estimates.

Fang Yuan hears Gu Immortal fighting far off and concludes that Hei Lou Lan’s side has begun attacking captivating sea. He treats an open strike on that restricted area as a huge commotion that cannot stay hidden from other demonic path Gu Immortals in the blessed land.

Hei Lou Lan and the others stop their captivating-sea assault and fight Dong Fang Chang Fan in the air. He later flies into captivating sea, breaks the illusion, and finds the peach tree sea in a pathetic state. The peach wolf group has mostly been killed down to two or three, with wolf corpses yet to be taken away near the trees. A jade green light rises from captivating sea as Miniscule Mountain after a miniman Gu Immortal answers Dong Fang Chang Fan’s call for aid under their mutual agreement, and Dong Fang Chang Fan holds the mountain as he resumes the fight. Hei Lou Lan regrets going all in: many demons defeated the peach wolf group by force, yet that was not enough for Miniscule Mountain to use its killer move.
